# Panel

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use a panel to highlight the outcome of an important action, especially successful completion of a transaction.

## When to use

- Use at the top of a confirmation page to tell users that they completed an important action.
- Include a reference number or other short result in the body when users must retain it.

## When not to use

- Do not use a panel for routine information, warnings or validation errors.
- Do not rely on the panel as the entire confirmation page; follow it with what happens next.

## Anatomy

- **Confirmation panel (required):** A govuk-panel govuk-panel--confirmation container carries the highlighted outcome.
- **Title (required):** A concise heading states the successful result and is normally the page h1.
- **Body:** Optional content shows a reference or another immediately important detail.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Confirmation | `div` | `govuk-panel`, `govuk-panel--confirmation` | The primary outcome at the start of a confirmation page. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- No GOV.UK JavaScript module is required.
- Render the panel after the server has completed or authoritatively confirmed the action, not as an optimistic client-only state.
- Follow the panel with details about next steps, timing, records and support.

## Accessibility contract

- Use an h1 for the confirmation title when it is the page's main heading.
- Ensure the result is explicit in text and not conveyed only by the green background.
- When navigation moves to the confirmation page, make the page title and heading identify the completed task.

## Content rules

- State the outcome directly, such as “Application complete”.
- Label any reference number and make it easy to copy accurately.
- Do not use celebratory or vague copy that obscures what was completed.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.success`
- `govuk.color.inverse-text`
- `govuk.typography.weight.bold`

## HTML examples

### Application confirmation

```html
<div class="govuk-panel govuk-panel--confirmation">
  <h1 class="govuk-panel__title">Application complete</h1>
  <div class="govuk-panel__body">Your reference number<br><strong>HDJ2123F</strong></div>
</div>
```
